name: psychic-gateway-process.pdf
description: A 1983 report by Army Lt. Col. Wayne McDonnell assessing the Monroe Institute's Gateway Experience, a course that uses audio tapes to synchronize the brain's hemispheres (Hemi-Sync). It tries to explain the course's claims of out-of-body states and perception beyond time and space in terms of physics, drawing on Itzhak Bentov's models.
